packageRules.description: Wait three days before taking a new GitHub Actions release. Non-major action updates merge without the owner once CI is green, and a compromised action usually ships as a fresh release that is found and pulled within days; this is the window in which it can be caught before it reaches a workflow that holds a write token or the module signing key. Scoped to github-actions so the images.yaml manager and digest updates are not held back. Fork delta P7 in FORK-PATCHES.md.
